title: Transmission Tote
object: 16 oz natural canvas, 15 x 16 in, gusseted, single-colour screen print.
wall_label: The infection map reduces to four fields. Origin, vector, host, outcome. Epidemiologists use the same four to track a pathogen through a population. The fields work equally well on an idea, which is either a useful analogy or a warning about how easily one idea replaces another.

notes.Printed text: ORIGIN: forum crypt. VECTOR: screenshots. HOST: group chat. OUTCOME: resurrection.
